parsed.explanation: Traveller-facing exposure is high. Section 379 criminalises presenting as a woman for any male-assigned person, applying to visitors on appearance alone, with a 3-month maximum. The dossier does not document its enforcement, so it is weighted as a statute on the books, not an enforced lever. The stronger evidence is state conduct: security forces were reported to harass, arrest, detain, torture and beat LGBTQI+ persons across 2018-2022. The 2017 raid on a rights group, with staff detained for months, and the ministerial detention threat (not confirmed as carried out) show state-directed targeting. Hostile government rhetoric has driven most openly LGBTQI+ citizens to flee. There is no hate-crime or anti-discrimination protection, no visible recourse, and the NGO Act constrains support structures. Data on document rules, entry screening and custody placement for trans people is absent, so I extrapolated from the criminalising regime, the torture record and the absence of relief. Sits in the high-risk band, just above severe.
